messages:
jasper: Heads-up — launching adaptive-window-coalescer v2 to canary (eng-runtime). Small runtime tweak but benching shows a solid efficiency win.
mira: sweet. can we see the numbers?
jasper: quick run (chat-short, seq=32):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=32)
Baseline    p50=9.8ms  p95=36.4ms  cost=0.089 units
AWC v2      p50=7.2ms  p95=34.6ms  cost=0.074 units  (-16.9% cost)
```
li: p95 improvement modest but p50 and cost look great. any tail surprises (p99)?
jasper: p99 unchanged in harness. This is mostly smarter window sizing + adaptive backoff for tiny requests. No kernel/CUDA changes.
ops-bot: canary rollout started for adaptive-window-coalescer v2 (4% us-central) :rocket:
henry: Ops note — i've added a shortlink to the perf dash (coalescer awc-v2) on #oncall. Watch p99/p95 and error-rate. https://console.redwood/perf/awc-v2
mira: runtime impact? CPU/mem?
jasper: CPU +2% on canary nodes, memory neutral. Net KV-prefix hit improved by ~2.4pp because we avoid premature lookups for short prefixes.
li: what's the rollback gate?
jasper: Gate: p99 >6% regression OR error-rate spike >0.5% -> rollback. Staged plan: 4% -> 25% at T+90m -> 70% at T+8h -> 100% T+36h if clean.
perf-bot: canary-smoke checks passed 1m window. no regressions detected. :white_check_mark:
mira: config toggles?
jasper: snippet we flipped on canary:
```yaml
enable_adaptive_window_coalescer: true
min_window_ms: 3
max_window_ms: 18
aggressive_backoff_pct: 0.2
coalesce_prefetch_reorder: true
```
li: any customer-facing telemetry? we should tag the tenant metrics for first 24 hours.
jasper: yes tagging enabled. i'm kicking per-tenant cost-diff job now and will post results to #finance and #product.
henry: small FYI — load tests with synthetic burst patterns showed ~12% fewer backend tokens due to reduced duplicate prefix lookups.
mira: awesome. when do we share a brief with execs?
jasper: i'll draft a 1-paragraph summary after the 25% checkpoint and ping growth/product.
perf-bot: regression-check completed 10m window 1: no regressions.
jasper: thanks team. will report back at the 90-minute mark or earlier if gates trip. big win for short-chat workloads. :party:
